name: motionmaker
description: Make frame-exact motion graphics with Claude: one /motionmaker command that works like a studio: pre-production first (describe what you picture, a brief-back to confirm, numbered mood boards and motion-feel videos to choose from, script, storyboard and animatic, approvals recorded in your words), voice-over via an ElevenLabs connector or your own recording, an art director, a frame-locked brief, renders, reviews, adds synthesized sound and exports MP4/GIF. Includes reference-video analysis, a motion-technique catalog matcher, illustration and animation assets (Open Peeps, Humaaans, LottieFiles, Rive) with a licence ledger, optional libraries (bundled fonts per look, code reveals, equations, globe maps, hand-drawn marks, icon sets, frame-exact footage), art styles (Bauhaus, Van Gogh, Constructivism, Seurat, Matisse, ukiyo-e), beat-grid music, a finished-film gate with an independent reviewer and sealed delivery, an OpenMontage handoff for footage and AI-video work, 2D cel animation (inked drawings on twos, cel shading, smears, impact frames), flat design motion graphics (layered flat worlds, parallax camera, subtle effects, transitions), photoreal 3D through Blender (downloaded only on your yes), an animation-style board that shows each style moving before you choose, Anatomy machine explainers filmed frame-exactly (any real-time web page can be filmed), nineteen templates, Poly Haven CC0 3D models, HDRIs and materials (free API) and verification tools.
